description: Prawn sashimi and cucumber sushi, and the first sink. A counter runs down the middle, so the two halves meet only along the bottom row: boards, rice, prawns and nori on the left, the pots, the cucumbers and the sink on the right.
strategy: Split left and right. The left chef chops, plates and serves and throws raw rice across; the right chef boils the rice, washes up and throws cucumbers back. Throwing beats queueing at the one gap under the centre counter.
